newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate leaps 405 bps to 19.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate leaps 405 bps to 19.75 pct.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates were up 405 basis points to 19.75 percent in the final hour of trade on Tuesday.
Dealers said rates rose sharply on tight liquidity coupled with speculative trade by players attempting to force the central bank to raise rates at its weekly primary auction later in the day.
"A big player withheld a hefty liquidity position and several others needed cash," a trader said.
Traders said some brokers began to try to raise rates when it looked as if the central bank could lower primary rates at its weekly government securities auction later in the day.
Dealers added that part of the rise was due to a technical adjustment after late dip to 15.70 percent on Monday.
